$comment: branchshared.json is non-secret topology/identity material only. Future schema evolution must not add password, token, private key, connection string or credential-bearing fields without an ADR/spec amendment.
title: Dobby Branch Shared connection profile
description: Shape of branchshared.json, the non-secret Branch Shared topology/identity profile. Branch Shared runtime is deferred, so a valid file here enables design review only and never authorizes a Standalone runtime connection. Validity is a shape guarantee, not authorization.

connectionProfile.$comment: Connection profile fields may reference protected-storage records, but they must not store credential values or raw connection strings.

profileVersion.$comment: Pinned rather than open-ended. The previous "minimum": 1 accepted any future integer, so a profileVersion this shape does not describe validated as conforming and a reviewer could not tell which version the schema documents. Every other Dobby schema states its own version with a const; this was the sole exception. branchshared.json is unsigned local configuration and has no row in docs/schemas/artifact-compatibility-matrix.md, which governs signed versioned artifact families -- that matrix is not authority here, only the same no-silent-fallback principle. Rejection semantics and the widening obligation are stated by the owning spec, docs/specs/storage-and-data-protection.md. Branch Shared runtime is deferred, so no reader and no committed instance exists and this pin invalidates nothing; admitting a version 2 is an ADR/spec amendment that must also state how a version-1 profile migrates.

host.description: DNS hostname, IPv4 literal, or bracketed IPv6 literal. Port and URL scheme are not part of this field.
host.$comment: Valid examples: db.example.com, 127.0.0.1, [::1], [2001:db8::1]. Invalid examples: https://db.example.com, db.example.com:5432, empty string, [::::] (runtime strict parser rejects malformed IPv6).

branchDeploymentId.$comment: format is annotation-only in JSON Schema 2020-12, so the lowercase canonical UUID pattern carries the fail-closed assertion.

serverIdentityPinMaterial.description: Lowercase hex-encoded SHA-256 server identity pin material.

deviceProfileRef.description: Non-secret live reference to the Branch Shared device profile or registration record. This is distinct from audit localDeviceRef snapshot semantics.

runtimeCredentialRef.description: Protected-storage reference to the runtime dobby_app credential. The credential value is not stored in this JSON file.

setupCredentialRef.description: Optional protected-storage reference visible only to setup-authorized BranchSetup context, never normal Dobby.Host runtime.
